feeds.title: Communicating Psychological Science Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles on Mental Health, Brain Science, Feeling, Learning, Outreach, Pedagogy, Relationship, and Thinking. The main purpose of this blog is to promote the communication of psychological science to the public and the development of science communication abilities in undergraduate students.

feeds.title: School of Psychology Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles on acculturation, body image, social psychology, PhD life, student life, green tips, sustainability, creativity, developmental psychology, music, wellbeing, mental health, student entrepreneurs and more. The School of Psychology at the University of Sussex is one of the largest psychology departments in the UK, with world-leading researchers and a large community of undergraduate and postgraduate students. This blog intends to be a window into the life of the School, with contributions from students and staff.

feeds.title: The Learning Scientists Blog
feeds.description: We are cognitive psychological scientists interested in research on education. Our main research focus is on the science of learning. Our vision is to make scientific research on learning more accessible to students, teachers, and other educators.

feeds.title: OU Psychology & Counselling
feeds.description: A blog for the School of Psychology and Counselling at the Open University. Covers Psychology, Counselling, Forensic Psychology, and Social Psychology.

feeds.title: Learning & the Brain Blog
feeds.description: The Learning & the Brain Blog is designed to provide accessible syntheses of cutting-edge research that is relevant to educational practice, policy, culture, and strategy. The aim is to fill in the gaps between Learning & the Brain conferences and make practical, evidence-forward articles available to the Learning & The Brain community.

feeds.title: The Ed Psych Practice Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles on ADHD, Behaviour Strategies, Working Memory Difficulties, Traumas, Self Conscious, Social Anxiety, Adolescents, Mindfulness, Separation Anxiety, Communication Difficulties, Learning Difficulties, and Social Skills Awareness. Ed Psych therapists work on improving communication and pronunciation for any age group.

feeds.title: Educational Psychology CUNY Hub
feeds.description: Covers Educational Psychology, News and Research highlight, Student and Faculty news, Student spotlight, and Alumni news. All of these blog posts are written by students, faculty, and alumni.

feeds.title: The Calming Corner Blog
feeds.description: A School Psychologist's blog about counseling, organization, assessments tips, behavior plans, self-regulation, social thinking, technology, and more! Authored by Melissa, a School Psychologist in Connecticut.

feeds.title: My PPLS Journey
feeds.description: All the blogs are written by current students at the School of Philosophy, Psychology, and Language Sciences. It reflects their own student experiences and therefore these do not reflect the views of the University.

feeds.title: JEPS Bulletin Blog
feeds.description: The Official Blog of the Journal of European Psychology Students. Covers articles on APA Guidelines, Interviews, Literature research, Manuscript analysis, Presenting results, Research Methodology and Scientific writing.

feeds.title: Ed Psych Insight
feeds.description: A blog for thinking about how to help children and young people withadditional needs, and the adults who support them. Author Dr. Chris Moore is an Educational Psychologist and is passionate about topics such as attachment, trauma, mental health, and stress.

feeds.title: APA Style Blog
feeds.description: Style experts from the American Psychological Association share tips, tutorials, paper formatting, background about writing in APA Style, and learn the conventions of scholarly publishing.
